parameters.description:
`msg-to-d7networks-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your D7 Networks account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own D7 Networks accounts — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional D7 Networks accounts bound per enrollment.

Create a D7 Networks account at d7networks.com, then open your account profile's API Details section to copy your API Token — set this as D7NETWORKS_SMS_TOKEN. Set D7NETWORKS_SMS_FROM to the sender name you want recipients to see, and D7NETWORKS_SMS_TO to the destination phone number including its country code, e.g. +14155551234.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment D7 Networks destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to D7 Networks messages/v1/send
parameters.summary: Send an SMS to your own D7 Networks account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's D7NETWORKS_SMS_FROM value (same format as D7NETWORKS_SMS_FROM)

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's D7NETWORKS_SMS_TO value (same format as D7NETWORKS_SMS_TO)

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's D7 Networks token
